label: preparing
what: Likely preparing a gathering or feast in the great hall, possibly a surprise concealed behind the lighting inspection. Freight funded and supplied a 200-loaf order from baker; builder reports those fresh loaves ready alongside new hall lighting and plans to escort me at eighteen. Secretary arranged the inspection and escort; neighbour relays details. Their knowledge of a hidden purpose, and innkeeper's precise involvement beyond an account and spoiled batch, remain uncertain.
